mkdir -p /tmp/analysis_scripts && cat > /tmp/analysis_scripts/train.py <<'EOF'
import re, glob, os, sys
base = "/tmp/r2run-eswcfbgi/data/text"
files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "*.txt")))
print("files:", len(files))
rows = []
for f in files:
    txt = open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    # split into forms by RecommendationForm headers
    parts = re.split(r"=== page \d+", txt)
    for p in parts:
        if "Case Number" not in p and "RecommendationForm" not in p:
            continue
        cm = re.search(r"Case Number:\s*(\S+)", p)
        rm = re.search(r"Respondent:\s*(.*)", p)
        rec = re.search(r"recommends the following civil penalty:(.*?)Abstentions", p, re.S)
        recs = rec.group(1) if rec else ""
        rows.append((os.path.basename(f), cm.group(1) if cm else None, rm.group(1).strip() if rm else None, recs))
print("forms:", len(rows))
import collections
print("missing case:", sum(1 for r in rows if r[1] is None), "missing rec:", sum(1 for r in rows if not r[3].strip()))
pos = 0; tr = 0; trw = 0
for fn, c, resp, rec in rows:
    m = re.search(r"\$\$?\s?\d[\d,]*(?:,\s\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?", rec)
    head = m is not None
    if head:
        pos += 1
        if re.search(r"training", rec, re.I): tr += 1
        if re.search(r"\btraining\b", rec, re.I): trw += 1
print("with $:", pos, "training substring:", tr, "training word:", trw)
print("pct:", round(100*tr/pos,1) if pos else None, round(100*trw/pos,1) if pos else None)
EOF
python3 -I /tmp/analysis_scripts/train.py
